title: Broncos elevate S Taylor Rapp and CB/KR Sam Fresch Jr. from the practice squad

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos elevate S Taylor Rapp and CB/KR Sam Fresch Jr. from the practice squad
sources.description: According to 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, the Denver Broncos are elevating veteran safety Taylor Rapp and return specialist/cornerback Sam Fresch Jr. from the practice squad for Sunday’s game vs. the Arizona Cardinals. Rapp started and played significant snaps in place of veteran starting safety Talanoa Hufanga, who was sidelined with an injury last week vs. […]
